name: Jehoram
summary: The firstborn son of Jehoshaphat, who ruled Judah from Jerusalem for eight years. He married a daughter of Ahab, did evil, and died of a painful disease with no one sorry to see him go.

key_moments.title: Loses Edom in a Revolt
key_moments.description: In Jehoram's days Edom rebelled against Judah and made its own king. Jehoram struck the Edomites by night at Zair, but Edom stayed free of Judah.

key_moments.title: Kills His Brothers
key_moments.description: When Jehoram took his father's throne, he killed all his brothers with the sword. With Ahab's daughter as his wife, he followed the evil ways of Israel's kings.

key_moments.title: Struck by the Disease Elijah Foretold
key_moments.description: A letter came to him from the prophet Elijah, warning of a plague on his house and a disease of his bowels. Raiders carried off his sons and wives, and after two years he died of the disease and was not buried with the kings.
